title: Causal inference in staggered adoption panels: The correct comparison set depends on your intervention
abstract: arXiv:2610.31537v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A powerful data structure for causal inference is staggered adoption: many units are observed over many time periods, during which some units adopt an irreversible treatment at various time points while others remain untreated. Popular methods that apply in this setting include difference in difference, fixed effects, matching, and synthetic control. All of these methods compare the future outcomes of treatment adopters and non-adopters to answer the question: for units who adopt treatment, what outcomes would have been realized if they had remained untreated? We show that this question actually hides two very different causal questions of interest. The first is what would have happened under a momentary intervention to prevent treatment at its factual adoption time. The second is what would have happened to a treated unit under a longitudinal ban preventing treatment at all periods until outcome measurement. We show how to answer each

translated_title: 交错采纳面板中的因果推断：正确的比较集取决于你的干预类型
translated_abstract: 交错采纳是因果推断中一种强大的数据结构：在多个时间段内观察大量单元，其中一些单元在不同时间点采取不可逆的处理，而其他单元始终保持未处理状态。适用于这种设定的流行方法包括双重差分、固定效应、匹配和合成控制。所有这些方法都通过比较处理采纳者与未采纳者的未来结果，来回答如下问题：对于采取处理的单元，如果它们保持未处理状态，会实现怎样的结果？我们表明，这个问题实际上隐藏了两个截然不同且都值得关注因果问题。第一个是：如果在事实采纳时刻进行一次瞬时干预以阻止处理，会发生什么？第二个是：如果在纵向禁令下阻止处理直到结果测量时刻，被处理单元会发生什么？我们展示了如何分别回答这两个问题。
tldr: 本文揭示了交错采纳面板中的因果推断实际上包含两种不同的因果问题——采纳时刻的瞬时干预与持续到结果测量的纵向禁令——并指出正确的比较集选择取决于所研究的干预类型。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that causal inference in staggered adoption panels conceals two distinct causal questions—a momentary intervention at the adoption time versus a longitudinal ban until outcome measurement—and the correct comparison set depends on which intervention is of interest.
